clauses.title: Grounds of Complaint
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 9
clauses.text: 9. Grounds of Complaint Any customer aggrieved by an act or omission of a Bank resulting in deficiency in service may file a complaint under the Scheme personally or through an authorised representative as defined under clause 3(1)(c).
clauses.query: grounds of complaint act or omission of bank resulting in deficiency in service

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 3(1)
clauses.text: (i) “Deficiency in service” means a shortcoming or an inadequacy in any service, which the Bank is required to provide statutorily or otherwise, which may or may not result in financial loss or damage to the customer; (j) “Non-Banking Financial Company” (NBFC) means an NBFC as defined in Section 45-I (f) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and registered with the Reserve Bank, to the extent included under the Scheme but does not include, an NBFC in resolution or winding up/liquidation, or under Directions of Reserve Bank of India; (k) “Non- bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer” means a company, as defined in the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), which has been granted a Certificate of Authorisation by the Reserve Bank of India under Section 7(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007) to operate as a Prepaid Payment Instrument Issuer; (l) “RBI Deputy Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (m) “RBI Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (n) “Regulated Entity” means a bank or a Non-Banking Financial Company, or a Non - bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer or a Credit Information Company as defined in the Scheme, or any other entity as may be specified by the Reserve Bank from time to time, to the extent not excluded under the Scheme; This is Public document. (o) “Rejected Complaints” means complaints that are closed under the provisions as specified in clause 16 of the Scheme. (p) “Settlement” means an outcome of the processes under clause 14 of the Scheme; (q) “The Reserve Bank” means Reserve Bank of India constituted under Section 3 of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
clauses.query: grounds of complaint act or omission of bank resulting in deficiency in service

draft: I am writing to report an unauthorized UPI transaction of ₹18,500 from my SBI account that occurred last night at 11:00 PM. I did not authorize this payment, nor did I share any OTP. I received a suspicious call from an individual claiming to be a bank representative, but I did not disclose any sensitive information. I have already reported this incident to GPay and have received an SMS notification from the bank regarding this deduction. As this unauthorized transaction indicates a security breach and potential deficiency in service [C1], [C2], I request your urgent guidance on the steps required to recover these funds and secure my account. I understand that I must report this incident to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and will do so immediately. Please provide a formal response regarding the investigation status and the necessary documentation required from my end to facilitate the reversal of this amount. I request a response within 7 days.
subject: Unauthorized UPI transaction of ₹18,500 from SBI account
summary: Aapke SBI account se ₹18,500 ka unauthorized transaction hua hai. Aapne GPay par report kar diya hai, lekin abhi cybercrime.gov.in par report karna zaroori hai. Is letter mein bank se investigation aur refund ke liye guidance maangi gayi hai.

escalation.name: Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer
escalation.when_to_use: First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint number; escalate to the Principal Nodal Officer if unresolved.

escalation.name: RBI Ombudsman (RB-IOS, 2026)
escalation.when_to_use: No reply within 30 days, or the reply is unsatisfactory. Also crpc@rbi.org.in. No fee.

escalation.name: District Consumer Commission
escalation.when_to_use: Deficiency in banking service is also a consumer dispute.

critic_notes: The reference id is unknown - write the placeholder [TRANSACTION / COMPLAINT REFERENCE].

Reviewer: The letter fails to mention that the user has not yet filed a complaint with the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or local police, which is a critical step for unauthorized transaction cases and was noted in the user's review answers.

## If there's no reply
1. **Bank grievance cell → Principal Nodal Officer** (email / bank complaint portal — epg.cms@sbi.co.in) — First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint number; escalate to the Principal Nodal Officer if unresolved.
2. **RBI Ombudsman (RB-IOS, 2026)** (RBI CMS portal / email) — No reply within 30 days, or the reply is unsatisfactory. Also crpc@rbi.org.in. No fee. https://cms.rbi.org.in · 14448 (RBI contact centre)
3. **District Consumer Commission** (online filing (e-Jagriti)) — Deficiency in banking service is also a consumer dispute. https://e-jagriti.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._

cited.text: 9. Grounds of Complaint Any customer aggrieved by an act or omission of a Bank resulting in deficiency in service may file a complaint under the Scheme personally or through an authorised representative as defined under clause 3(1)(c).

cited.title: Definitions
cited.citation: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, Clause 3(1)
cited.text: (i) “Deficiency in service” means a shortcoming or an inadequacy in any service, which the Bank is required to provide statutorily or otherwise, which may or may not result in financial loss or damage to the customer; (j) “Non-Banking Financial Company” (NBFC) means an NBFC as defined in Section 45-I (f) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and registered with the Reserve Bank, to the extent included under the Scheme but does not include, an NBFC in resolution or winding up/liquidation, or under Directions of Reserve Bank of India; (k) “Non- bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer” means a company, as defined in the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), which has been granted a Certificate of Authorisation by the Reserve Bank of India under Section 7(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007) to operate as a Prepaid Payment Instrument Issuer; (l) “RBI Deputy Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (m) “RBI Ombudsman” means a person appointed by the Reserve Bank as such under Clause 4 of the Scheme; (n) “Regulated Entity” means a bank or a Non-Banking Financial Company, or a Non - bank Prepaid Payment Instruments Issuer or a Credit Information Company as defined in the Scheme, or any other entity as may be specified by the Reserve Bank from time to time, to the extent not excluded under the Scheme; This is Public document. (o) “Rejected Complaints” means complaints that are closed under the provisions as specified in clause 16 of the Scheme. (p) “Settlement” means an outcome of the processes under clause 14 of the Scheme; (q) “The Reserve Bank” means Reserve Bank of India constituted under Section 3 of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
